title: Less than 4 minutes of vigorous exercise a day could halve your dementia risk | New Scientist
description: Bursts of vigorous physical activity, such as carrying heavy shopping or rushing for the bus, seem to have a significant effect on our brain health and dementia risk
author: Chris Simms

title: Parkinson’s may be driven by 'vicious cycle' that disrupts brain waste drainage | New Scientist
description: Parkinson's disease is linked to toxic protein clumps and disrupted brain waste removal, which may feed off each other, causing the condition to progress
author: Carissa Wong

title: Hubble Space Telescope is falling to Earth – should NASA save it? | New Scientist
description: The Hubble Space Telescope faces a fiery and fatal re-entry to Earth's atmosphere sometime around 2032, but NASA is asking the private sector for ideas to keep it working
author: Matthew Sparkes

title: Tomb in Siberia reveals humans were using cannabis 2800 years ago | New Scientist
description: Psychoactive compounds have been found in a hair from a Scythian tomb in Siberia, providing the earliest direct evidence of cannabis being used as a drug
author: Chris Simms

title: The economic benefits of the covid vaccines may be double what we thought | New Scientist
description: The global health and economic benefits of the covid-19 vaccines were thought to have reached up to $38 trillion in their first year, but a new analysis suggests $64.3 trillion is a more accurate figure
author: Shosha Adie

title: Evidence of active volcanoes on Mars may boost chances of finding life | New Scientist
description: Recent fractures on the surface of Mars and gases detected by an orbiter probe provide some of the strongest evidence yet that the planet is volcanically active
author: Matthew Sparkes
